title: dVRK teleop ecm
description:
Configuration file format for the dVRK ECM tele-operation component. This schema is used for the [dVRK console configuration](dvrk-console.html).

 - For details of implementation, see code under `sawIntuitiveResearchKit/core/components/code/mtsTeleOperationECMTwoHands.cpp` and `mtsTeleOperationECMOneHand.cpp`
 - [Schema file](dvrk-teleop-ecm.schema.json)

oneOf.description: Two-hands ECM teleoperation requires MTML and MTMR

MTM.description: Name of surgeon's MTM arm to be used for single-hand teleoperation (`MTMR`, `MTML`...). The arm must have been declared in the main system configuration file under "arms".

MTML.description: Name of surgeon's left side MTM arm to be used (`MTML`, `MTML1`...). The arm must have been declared in the main system configuration file under "arms".

MTMR.description: Name of surgeon's right side MTM arm to be used (`MTMR`, `MTMR1`...). The arm must have been declared in the main system configuration file under "arms".

ECM.description: Name of patient's side ECM arm to be used (`ECM`, `ECM1`...). The arm must have been declared in the main system configuration file under "arms".

type.description:
Type of teleoperation.  This determines which class should be used to instantiate the ECM teleoperation.

 - `TELEOP_ECM_TWO_HANDS` corresponds to the default two-hand class provided for the dVRK.
 - `TELEOP_ECM_ONE_HAND` corresponds to the single-hand class provided for the dVRK.
 - `TELEOP_ECM_TWO_HANDS_DERIVED` corresponds to classes derived from the two-hand ECM teleoperation base class.
 - `TELEOP_ECM_ONE_HAND_DERIVED` corresponds to classes derived from the single-hand ECM teleoperation base class.
 - `TELEOP_ECM_TWO_HANDS_GENERIC` corresponds to two-hand classes not derived from the dVRK base.
 - `TELEOP_ECM_ONE_HAND_GENERIC` corresponds to single-hand classes not derived from the dVRK base.

period.description: Override the default periodicity of the teleoperation class. Most user should steer away from changing the default periodicity.

configure_parameter.description: Configuration passed to the teleoperation component after its creation. It is used by the component's `Configure` method.

scale.description: Scale factor applied to insertion motion

check_MTMs_workspace.description: Check MTM positions against the standard surgeon-console workspace before enabling ECM teleoperation.

MTM_is_haptic.description: Set false for non-motorized alternate MTMs.  This disables MTM effort, gravity-compensation, and orientation-lock commands.

haptic_feedback_ratio.description: Scale factor applied to the ECM teleoperation wrench sent to MTM.
